Commission process

From first enquiry to completed shastar.

The configurators create a starting specification. The final commission only begins after the full build has been reviewed and confirmed.

01

Choose or enquire

Select an available piece, or use the larger or smaller builder to describe the commission.

02

Review the build

Akaali checks dimensions, compatibility, material, origin, decorative work and intended use.

03

Confirm in writing

The final specification, price, lead time, deposit and shipping position are confirmed before production.

04

Complete and deliver

Final photographs, balance and delivery arrangements are handled when the piece is complete.

Ranges and materials

Range names do not replace the steel specification.

Every quotation should identify the actual construction and origin, rather than relying only on labels such as Standard, Jangi or Ustaad.

Standard Range

Accessible, practical builds with simpler fittings and clearly stated Punjab-made or traditional spring-steel options.

Jangi Range

Function-focused builds using confirmed heat-treatable high-carbon or silicon spring steels and suitable construction.

Ustaad / Bespoke

Individually developed work with advanced shaping, specialist mutha, engraved fittings, koftgari or custom references.

Origin matters. A piece may be made in Punjab, made in New Zealand, or made in Punjab and fitted or finished in New Zealand. The exact path should be stated on the item or quotation.

Why Akaali

A specialist shastar catalogue and commission studio.

The site keeps the original silhouettes and detailed option photography, but now places them inside a clearer public storefront and enquiry process.

Exact item identity

Available pieces should have an item number, exact images, dimensions, material, origin, edge condition, price and status.

Visual commissioning

The retained builders show blade silhouettes, mutha photographs, myaan references, koftgari and engraving choices.

Human review

Calculated totals remain estimates. Handmade variation, compatibility, shipping and final requirements are reviewed directly.

Common questions

Before submitting an enquiry

Are the pieces shown in the builders available now?

No. The builders contain commission options and visual references. Only pieces explicitly listed or confirmed as available should be treated as finished stock.

Is the live total a final quote?

No. It is an indicative estimate. Final price depends on the reviewed specification, material availability, workmanship, origin and shipping.

Where are the shastars made?

Akaali may offer Punjab-made pieces, New Zealand-made work, and builds involving work in both locations. The exact origin is confirmed for each item.

Is international shipping guaranteed?

No. Shipping depends on the destination, courier restrictions and applicable import or possession requirements.
